The user explicitly asked for exactly 15 valid four-letter cooking-related words on 2023-05-28. After correcting invalid abbreviations, words with the wrong number of letters, and a word whose meaning did not fit, the assistant supplied 15 words: bake, boil, chop, sear, melt, stir, fold, dice, cure, stew, whip, toss, beat, sift, and zest. The repeated corrections show the user expects exact compliance with word-length constraints and rejects abbreviations used to disguise longer words.
